tools.name: search_moments
tools.description: Search the moments Real Alpha cut from long interviews with the people building AI. Matches the words of `query` against what each moment is about, the speaker's quote and its takeaways, best match first. Filter by who is talking (`person`), a company (someone from it talking, or it being discussed)

tools.name: get_moment
tools.description: One moment in full, by its slug (from search results) or its realalpha.app/s/ link: the speaker and what they do, the show and date, their quote, the summary and takeaways, its topics, the big questions it answers and how, and the episode's other best minutes.

tools.name: what_did_they_say
tools.description: What one person said in the interviews Real Alpha cut, newest first: every moment where they are talking, or only those on a topic, best match first. Also says who they are and links their page on Real Alpha, which lists all of it.

tools.name: answers_to
tools.description: How the people building AI answer one of the big questions people ask about it, from the moments Real Alpha cut: grouped by which way they answer, the biggest group first, each with what the speaker says, who they are, the show and date. tools.description: About a minute of an episode's transcript, from a second into the video, for an episode Real Alpha cut: the lines with their times and, where the transcript says, who is talking, plus the link that plays the episode from there. tools.name: latest_moments
tools.description: The newest moments Real Alpha cut, newest episode first: each episode's best minutes, from every show or only one.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "answers_to" is 2237 chars, far longer than this server's median (300). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
